text:
rachel: kicking off quiet-window deploy for inference-proxy v1.7. Plan: surgical feature_toggle llm_experiment rollout: 0 -> 0.02 (canary 6 hosts) -> 0.15 -> 0.5 -> 1.0 over ~35m. enterprise customers pinned to model=v3.2 until final approval. release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-25/inference-proxy-v1.7

tom: ACK. please insert deploybot holdpoint after the 0.15 step. gates: error_rate > 1.2% OR p95 latency +20% OR quality_regress > 1.0% -> pause and page oncall. enable soft-session-drain 7m for canary. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: created canary set S (6 hosts). feature_toggle llm_experiment -> 0.02. telemetry stream /ops/telemetry/deploy/7932104567 live. holdpoint scheduled at step 3.

kevin: running quick smoke + regression probe (smoke_delta set). quality gate: exact_match_loss <= 1.0% and rouge_delta <= 0.9%. also watching fallback-rate and cache-hit ratio. sampling traces at 4%.

rachel: routing-pin applied: enterprise cohort -> model=v3.2 enforced until gate passes. Support playbook updated. posting concise release note to #release-notes after final gate.

tom: rollback snippet for ops clipboard:
```
# revert flag and drain canary
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/llm_experiment -d '{"value":0}'
deploybot action: drain --set canaryS --grace 420
```

deploybot: canary S @ +5m metrics: error_rate=0.5% p95=210ms (+8%) token_cost=+4% fallback_rate=0.4%. smoke_delta OK. Proceeding to 0.15 in 8m.

kevin: infra note: requesting +12% autoscale headroom at +12m just in case. infra team looped.

rachel: good. if p50 regresses >15% or any gate trips, tom will fast-drain and pin routing back. otherwise scheduled promote to 1.0 at 00:40 UTC unless stopped. updates every 10m or on gate trip. :eyes:

support: acknowledged, prepping customer-facing blurb and rollback steps in Zendesk snippet.
